stage0019_03:r_1263541f4071624e.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Ready, $$シンジ$$?
　We're starting the simulation.」

stage0019_03:r_38762a09460d8b6b.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Every Angel has a part called its Core.
　Destroying it is the only way to wipe one out.
　So aim there, center the target and flip the switch...」

stage0019_03:r_7ab28e70b4d4f641.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Handle this precisely, and let your body learn it.」

stage0019_03:r_ec335e69f984b8b3.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Remember this, $$シンジ$$.
　This training will surely help you later.
　So we're doing this thoroughly.」

stage0019_03:r_1af20fccc3c53cfc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Center the target and flip the switch...」

stage0019_03:r_f951916061232dcd.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Center the target and flip the switch...
　Center the target and flip the switch...
　Center the target and flip the switch...」

stage0019_03:r_da2132b5038ec737.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンジ$$'s training sure is dragging on...」

stage0019_03:r_a653c8dec4c0f06f.text:
$$甲児$$
「What, is that some rivalry thing?」

stage0019_03:r_86d493e37a9799a7.text:
$n
「It's not that.
　I just do what I need to do.」

stage0019_03:r_09d0fcc600cdd3df.text:
$$葵$$
「Then we'll be your sparring partners today.」

stage0019_03:r_182faded068c15ed.text:
$$くらら$$
「Get ready.
　We'll take you on with five
　Variable Beast Machines.」

stage0019_03:r_9c206d19bfda4bd5.text:
$n
「Multiple against one, huh...
　Just what I wanted.」

stage0019_03:r_6e558bc69acf5bf3.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Rhinos' speed is the best there is!
　Just try dodging my charge, if you can!」

stage0019_03:r_d60d0818e965232f.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「No, $$朔哉$$. You should say,
　'Rhinos charges ahead of the competition!'」

stage0019_03:r_5b23687574286204.text:
$$エイーダ$$
「And instead of 'Try dodging my charge,'
　how about 'Dodge this, or you'll get the point!'?」

stage0019_03:r_6fd86c96891ea942.text:
$$朔哉$$
「Stop turning me into a walking rhino joke!」

stage0019_03:r_43e4e548c0b28376.text:
$$スズネ$$
「A week since $$シンジ$$ joined the Crusher Team...
　I wonder if he's settled in even a little...」

stage0019_03:r_d80a9688790ed583.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Even that quiet $n is managing just fine.
　No need to worry.」

stage0019_03:r_7b6f159eeaf4de0f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I get what you're trying to say.
　Miss $$スズネ$$, you're bothered that timid,
　withdrawn kid agreed to pilot the EVA, right?」

stage0019_03:r_ff6f8bdca2dd2bc9.text:
$$竜馬$$
「That wasn't his own will.
　...Obediently going along with what others say...
　That's probably just his way of getting by.」

stage0019_03:r_3f4035fd9db81258.text:
$$スズネ$$
「In the end, is $$シンジ$$ just being pushed
　around by what's convenient for adults...?」

stage0019_03:r_567b361a454c4b73.text:
$$竜馬$$
「...Can't deny that.
　But adults who just impose on him are failures.」

stage0019_03:r_d22851aaafbbf8fc.text:
$$竜馬$$
「If we mean to act like adults,
　we need to show these kids, him included, a way forward.」

stage0019_03:r_79f2664edb1af798.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Buck up, teacher.
　You became a teacher to be that kind of adult, right?」

stage0019_03:r_1c5aa0d15ae24846.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Well... you've got your hands full with problem kids,
　and as for me, aside from fighting,
　I'm hopeless at that kind of thing...」

stage0019_03:r_53bb64ee17750ee2.text:
$$竜馬$$
「I know someone who'd be perfect for this,
　but unluckily, they're not here...」

stage0019_03:r_7a7add80fde475ba.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Oh, $$竜馬$$'s hitting on Miss $$スズネ$$!」

stage0019_03:r_2103f6df2ea2e447.text:
$$正太郎$$
「That's suspicious.
　For $$竜馬$$ to be this flustered...」

stage0019_03:r_a12e3e130d896ff7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$正太郎$$, you too!? What are you saying!」

stage0019_03:r_b6f7b219eb4bd64b.text:
$$スズネ$$
「...Being linked to me that much bothers you...?」

stage0019_03:r_ee220318b96ab538.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I dunno, $$竜馬$$...
　$n's glaring at you.」

stage0019_03:r_c304df6888eb78f7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「N-no, $n, it's not like that!
　As fellow staff at Jindai High,
　I'm just teaching adult wisdom...!」

stage0019_03:r_c26958634526e597.text:
$n
「...Do as you like, it's fine.
　Miss $$スズネ$$ and I are just partners
　when we pilot the $$ジェニオン$$.」

stage0019_03:r_cdb750c9d380881a.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Then quit giving me that dead-eyed stare!」

stage0019_03:r_95fda74613c97b39.text:
$$甲児$$
「Heh... now that's a rare sight.」

stage0019_03:r_1956994937f8171e.text:
$$葵$$
「Didn't expect Demon $$流竜馬$$ to fluster this bad.」

stage0019_03:r_48f49f6728c15612.text:
$$くらら$$
「And $n's jealousy on top of it.」

stage0019_03:r_f02c37d91387d0ad.text:
$$スズネ$$
「All right, everyone.
　$$シンジ$$'s training should be wrapping up soon.」

stage0019_03:r_6bbd5a3c5afb87e0.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Miss $$スズネ$$'s right!
　Director $$大塚$$ told us, didn't he!
　All of you, go welcome him back!」

stage0019_03:r_291280e5f7eb9d70.text:
$$甲児$$
「Good work, $$シンジ$$.
　Let's get some food soon.」

stage0019_03:r_1f4337d6d393fc37.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But I need to change out of my plug suit,
　so please, go on ahead without me.」

stage0019_03:r_4740e748fae085ee.text:
$$葵$$
「We can wait that long.
　Meals taste better when we all eat together.」

stage0019_03:r_b76524cd840e1d37.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Then I'll hurry and get changed.」

stage0019_03:r_730ffe18400abfc2.text:
$$タケル$$
「That felt like a bit of a whiff...」

stage0019_03:r_ffe0fca26da5cd38.text:
$$ジョニー$$
「Can't be helped.
　He doesn't feel it's real yet
　that he belongs to this unit.」

stage0019_03:r_bfb27f9eb2f7073e.text:
$$朔哉$$
「So basically, he hasn't found his place
　among us yet, huh...」

stage0019_03:r_859dfa27bcaafe30.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Seems like this'll take a while.」

stage0019_03:r_6214c11b1bca811e.text:
$$ナオト$$
「Overseeing $$シンジ$$'s training... rough work!」

stage0019_03:r_8eaf6f3098ffed12.text:
$$ミサト$$
「Thanks.
　But this is my job.」

stage0019_03:r_cf507214fe955d75.text:
$$さやか$$
「And $$ミサト$$'s settled in completely...」

stage0019_03:r_2113dcbabdfc758a.text:
$$くらら$$
「Mostly since the guys keep coming on to her.」

stage0019_03:r_4b0e43ba6a5f2f5b.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「But at this rate,
　$$シンジ$$'s going to stay half-hearted forever...」

stage0019_03:r_6a74519e1fc29c4b.text:
$$アキラ$$
「Isn't there something we can do, $$ロゼ$$?」

stage0019_03:r_95a3dd16c2c4cc3e.text:
$$ナオト$$
「You were closed off to us too,
　at first, weren't you?」

stage0019_03:r_4a14ec0c511c7f0d.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「That was guilt, for having served under $$ズール$$...」

stage0019_03:r_20cf167c0ec0d4d5.text:
$$タケル$$
「But $$ロゼ$$ regretted her past,
　and chose to fight for peace like we do.
　And so, she became one of us.」

stage0019_03:r_b591d812c96c6c99.text:
$$ロゼ$$
「Then if $$シンジ$$ felt the same way we do...」

stage0019_03:r_e350fa099c1ab072.text:
$n
「But no one can force that on someone.
　Only they can decide how they feel.」

stage0019_03:r_c33bd700553abf91.text:
$$ミサト$$
（Hmm... I thought getting him around kids
　his own age would set him on a better path,
　but this is turning out to be a long road...）

stage0019_03:r_feee5c91826230e1.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「So, you're all here.
　Everyone, assemble in the salon, now.」

stage0019_03:r_bccc48e1964ad22d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Huh... you mean hurry up and eat?」

stage0019_03:r_f8736aaaa216c766.text:
$$ケンジ$$
「That's not it.
　The Crusher Team's received deployment orders.
　This is the briefing.」

stage0019_03:r_9be1a4c10bb62515.text:
$$甲児$$
「...A 《$$界震$$》 warning in Nagano, huh...」

stage0019_03:r_94a88c90e557e16e.text:
$$さやか$$
「The boundary's been stable since the $$新世時空震動$$,
　so $$界震$$s have barely happened at all.」

stage0019_03:r_1c208ca0cbf26f28.text:
$$さやか$$
「Hope it's not some kind of omen...」

stage0019_03:r_5b7ee307a700171a.text:
$$甲児$$
「But is this really okay?
　Us... leaving $$第３新東京市$$, I mean...」

stage0019_03:r_8d8f065c932da30a.text:
$$タケル$$
「Director $$大塚$$ said NERV's Commander Ikari
　reported no signs of an Angel appearing for now.」

stage0019_03:r_f5432119677514f7.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Can you actually tell when an Angel'll show up?」

stage0019_03:r_4e5c8e989c4a7691.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's classified NERV info, apparently,
　but since only they have any Angel intel,
　we've got no choice but to go with it.」

stage0019_03:r_adec86483b13599a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Huh....
　So maybe those Angels came from that third
　world the NERV people were in, huh...」

stage0019_03:r_2cf701bbcde3ec13.text:
$$タケル$$
「That's the only conclusion we can draw, but...」

stage0019_03:r_c17c58fdba72005e.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$シンジ$$, didn't you hear any of that?」

stage0019_03:r_f527e012803f7f1c.text:
$$甲児$$
「Weren't you listening to us talk...?」

stage0019_03:r_338f3b27e51dcc41.text:
$$甲児$$
「Get it together, $$シンジ$$.
　The EVA's on standby at $$ドラゴンズハイヴ$$ this mission,
　but you're still part of the Crusher Team.」

stage0019_03:r_0c8ea89b07432421.text:
$$タケル$$
「If a $$界震$$ hits,
　a 《$$ヘテロダイン$$》 could emerge from it.
　Our job is to deal with that.」

stage0019_03:r_be100a32b731708d.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Oh, right,
　you just got to this world, $$シンジ$$,
　so you wouldn't know about $$ヘテロダイン$$s.」

stage0019_03:r_702f82442fcec8a9.text:
$$甲児$$
「Simply put, a $$ヘテロダイン$$ is basically
　a mass of energy that shows up from a $$界震$$.」

stage0019_03:r_b1e38da4e8775ffe.text:
$$甲児$$
「It takes on a monster-like shape,
　but it's not really alive, so it has no will.」

stage0019_03:r_d2f1bf5ab2f0e41a.text:
$$甲児$$
「But given how huge they get,
　leaving them be causes damage all over,
　so we take them down quick.」

stage0019_03:r_2acc8ade0cc6dfa2.text:
$$シンジ$$
「A monster made of a mass of energy...」

stage0019_03:r_3dad695c99e9e052.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Don't worry.
　This world has pros for handling $$ヘテロダイン$$s.」

stage0019_03:r_66d4ae3a21caf881.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's right!
　$$ヘテロダイン$$s are the job of 《$$２１世紀警備保障$$》's
　$$ダイ・ガード$$!」

stage0019_03:r_0c18da7b3a37825d.text:
$$甲児$$
「We've been waiting, $$赤木$$!
　And $$いぶき$$, and $$青山$$ too!」

stage0019_03:r_abdb034ae8509702.text:
$$青山$$
「We're not the only ones who came.
　All of PR Section 2 is on this trip.」

stage0019_03:r_e51ecf6d6aa42e75.text:
$$赤木$$
「You're $n, right?
　$$ワッ太$$ told me about you.」

stage0019_03:r_b025267f22788233.text:
Akagi
「I'm $$赤木駿介$$.
　I'm with PR Section 2 at 《$$２１世紀警備保障$$》,
　and I also pilot $$ダイ・ガード$$.」

stage0019_03:r_8805f96e52aaa462.text:
$$甲児$$
「Come to think of it, $n
　came to Japan recently too, huh?」

stage0019_03:r_124591cb154fae64.text:
$$タケル$$
「$$界震$$s are unique to Japan,
　so it's no wonder you don't know about
　the anti-$$ヘテロダイン$$ $$ダイ・ガード$$.」

stage0019_03:r_7bdb6fecc8b3bde8.text:
$$いぶき$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$ was built about 15 years ago
　by the Security Force of the time, to
　counter the first $$ヘテロダイン$$ to appear.」

stage0019_03:r_4bf9b05b5f948170.text:
$$青山$$
「But no $$ヘテロダイン$$ ever showed up after
　that, so it became a useless relic...」

stage0019_03:r_eaa52d152f444bfd.text:
$$青山$$
「So the military set up a private firm
　to maintain and manage $$ダイ・ガード$$. That's
　how $$２１世紀警備保障$$, our company, was born.」

stage0019_03:r_b4bc9e9435b58e6f.text:
Ibuki
「I'm $$桃井いぶき$$.
　$$ダイ・ガード$$'s navigator.」

stage0019_03:r_a9227573166977a9.text:
Aoyama
「I'm $$青山圭一郎$$, $$ダイ・ガード$$'s
　engineer. Nice to meet you.」

stage0019_03:r_b0600ab9a9e8559d.text:
$n
「Salarymen who fight $$ヘテロダイン$$s...
　Just like $$ワッ太$$ said, they're pros in a literal sense.」

stage0019_03:r_7cbc63dad295f862.text:
$$赤木$$
「And these here are the members of PR
　Section 2, backing $$ダイ・ガード$$ from behind.」

stage0019_03:r_07f53c816e0a51f5.text:
$$大杉$$
「I'm Section Chief $$大杉$$.
　Our support for the Far East Branch has
　been officially approved, so I'll join you all.」

stage0019_03:r_2d09c6f6a2d990ea.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Ah, Chief $$大杉$$.
　We get to work together again.」

stage0019_03:r_0476ffd10c764b0e.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Takeo General Company, space's jack of
　all trades, and $$２１世紀警備保障$$ are rivals.」

stage0019_03:r_48c6c1ecfea6fe4a.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Though $$２１世紀警備保障$$ is way
　bigger as a company, though.」

stage0019_03:r_2b3479c4cf0680f4.text:
$$大杉$$
「President $$ワッ太$$, thanks for your help
　back then too. Our President $$大河内$$
　also sends his regards, again and again.」

stage0019_03:r_e370696b8936b08c.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「I'll be counting on you again, Chief.
　We're comrades in this fight from today.」

stage0019_03:r_9d7b02c5e728b7aa.text:
$$横沢$$
「As expected of President $$ワッ太$$.
　Still as straightforwardly manly as ever.」

stage0019_03:r_d7f1c506e78e55ff.text:
Yokozawa
「I'm $$横沢晋也$$, assistant chief.
　These are our section's members.」

stage0019_03:r_0c705091f748360e.text:
Ooyama
「I'm $$大山紀子$$.
　After $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$, I'll be helping out
　with the Crusher Team this time.」

stage0019_03:r_9eb8599304125b2f.text:
Nakahara
「I'm $$中原千秋$$.
　I'll do my very best.」

stage0019_03:r_a072aa25e5f521e0.text:
Tanigawa
「I'm $$谷川風花$$.
　Nice to meet you.」

stage0019_03:r_24e1a808a1609a1a.text:
Irie
「I'm $$入江静香$$.
　Pleased to make your acquaintance.」

stage0019_03:r_53128ce8f154fd06.text:
Ishizuka
「I'm $$石塚智美$$.
　And this is $$田口友朗$$ and $$伊集院博孝$$.」

stage0019_03:r_817b2773b4ed563e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「I've heard about all of you being
　the professionals against $$ヘテロダイン$$s.」

stage0019_03:r_1cc233cbc8c80af7.text:
$$大山$$
「Our $$大河内$$ has been pushing to expand
　the business, so during the Destruction
　Incident and the $$再世戦争$$, we joined $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$.」

stage0019_03:r_3ce2f3e58cfdc3ba.text:
$$谷川$$
「Our justice-freak $$赤木$$ seemed
　pretty happy about it, though.」

stage0019_03:r_e180b22d18f48d38.text:
$$赤木$$
「You don't need to praise me that much!」

stage0019_03:r_4d2a9066c4e7b27f.text:
$$スズネ$$
（Heh... deep down, he's really a champion of the people.）

stage0019_03:r_10340119af3ed6db.text:
$$甲児$$
「Then you should've joined the Crusher
　Team sooner. It's not like $$ヘテロダイン$$s
　have been showing up lately, either...」

stage0019_03:r_4f0aca6deda07883.text:
$$甲児$$
「Wh, what is it?
　That creepy laugh doesn't suit you...」

stage0019_03:r_8fe40600ce62dfbc.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$２１世紀警備保障$$ wasn't just goofing around.」

stage0019_03:r_ff4ce5f3cf96b617.text:
$$赤木$$
「It was all for a project meant to
　bring $$ダイ・ガード$$ back reborn!」

stage0019_03:r_d73c21f119847e35.text:
$$甲児$$
「$$ダイ・ガード$$ being reborn...!?」

stage0019_03:r_89766f5ffaa912d4.text:
$$いぶき$$
「The budget we'd requested for a while
　got approved, so $$ダイ・ガード$$ got a full makeover.」

stage0019_03:r_c2df6b71e3b4b6ec.text:
$$甲児$$
「So that's why, with the overhaul going
　on, $$ダイ・ガード$$ couldn't come out, huh.」

stage0019_03:r_451f726d4299ea35.text:
$$柿小路$$
「Hmm... as expected, the final tuning took a while.」

stage0019_03:r_e3d111e8bb190cb1.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's right.
　Which meant $$赤木$$ was under a lot of stress.」

stage0019_03:r_7c0d3c51f9a11ca0.text:
$$青山$$
「But even though it got powered up,
　$$界震$$s stopped happening at
　all, so the New $$ダイ・ガード$$ went to waste.」

stage0019_03:r_ab97c2b2418ea732.text:
$$青山$$
「That's why the Far East Branch's request
　for help was exactly what we needed.」

stage0019_03:r_2ddff5064af78db4.text:
$$赤木$$
「No $$界震$$s is a good thing, but
　with the world getting more unsettled,
　we can't just let $$ダイ・ガード$$ sit idle.」

stage0019_03:r_d583fcea31bdad2e.text:
$$スズネ$$
「They've got that good old-fashioned
　Japanese salaryman feel. I like it.」

stage0019_03:r_475f7653621a91b5.text:
$$赤木$$
「Those who don't work, don't eat, right?
　We'll do our part to keep the peace too.」

stage0019_03:r_1f418b5594cea300.text:
$$赤木$$
「I see, $n!
　I think you and I will get along fine!」

stage0019_03:r_f87fb889124bfaef.text:
$n
「I look forward to working with you, $$赤木$$.」

stage0019_03:r_79c90de32a79212d.text:
$$甲児$$
「Heh... even $n turns honest
　in front of $$赤木$$'s straight-shooting...」

stage0019_03:r_33f7fd55913419e8.text:
$$青山$$
「In front of this guy's carefree attitude,
　brooding or trying to act cool
　just starts to feel pointless.」

stage0019_03:r_473d9a88b4ca96e7.text:
$$赤木$$
「So where's the other new recruit,
　$$シンジ$$?」

stage0019_03:r_4de6ac85c63bac12.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Huh... he was right there a moment ago...」

stage0019_03:r_4c92652c9b1adf6f.text:
$$中原$$
「You mean the kid in the school uniform,
　about middle-school age? He left, though...」

stage0019_03:r_ce90563a934d49fb.text:
$$谷川$$
「He seemed like a sensitive kid, after all.
　Maybe he just couldn't keep up
　with $$赤木$$'s high energy?」

stage0019_03:r_d36072babd12aeb4.text:
$$シンジ$$
（...This op, I hear I don't have to sortie, but...）

stage0019_03:r_09ee921a85025fd3.text:
$$シンジ$$
（Then why... am I even here at all...）

stage0019_03:r_91c6d0bb53854ecc.text:
$$赤木$$
「Sorry!
　I didn't mean to startle you!」

stage0019_03:r_62ecd978c667bd29.text:
$$赤木$$
「You haven't done anything wrong,
　so there's no need to apologize.」

stage0019_03:r_b2aab8873350ea1f.text:
Akagi
「$$シンジ$$... right?
　I'm $$赤木駿介$$.
　Let's get along, okay?」

stage0019_03:r_653b741d07545dff.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$... are you anxious, maybe?」

stage0019_03:r_db0ee69ece206fcd.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's fine!
　$$ヘテロダイン$$s are tough foes, sure,
　but there's nothing to fear if we team up.」

stage0019_03:r_f97e6925c9e37332.text:
$$シンジ$$
「I... apparently don't have to sortie, so...」

stage0019_03:r_422861e0b8d77d0c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Then just cheer us on out there, okay?」

stage0019_03:r_ac21212c36d2b9ad.text:
$$赤木$$
「I, isn't there something you want to ask?
　I mean, I fought in $$ＺＥＸＩＳ$$ too, and
　believe it or not, I'm $$甲児$$'s piloting mentor.」

stage0019_03:r_a26e2108358af7a4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Robot piloting tips, how to turn
　things around when you're in a pinch,
　ask me anything you like.」

stage0019_03:r_017a56991b7b8ca4.text:
$$赤木$$
「Oh, I'm... a salaryman too, you know.
　Ask me about work or adult life if you
　want. Though I'm no good at school stuff or love talk!」

stage0019_03:r_bdc546b199c80996.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...$$赤木$$... what are you fighting for?」

stage0019_03:r_9c13714b3efbc7a8.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Are you fighting because it's your job?」

stage0019_03:r_96f156e19b53fc09.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's not it.
　I pilot $$ダイ・ガード$$ because I want to protect peace.」

stage0019_03:r_feb0390bba7fe1fb.text:
$$赤木$$
「It's not just me.
　$$甲児$$, $$タケル$$, $n... even $$ワッ太$$'s the same.」

stage0019_03:r_8a78bcec22029401.text:
$$シンジ$$
「...If people like that exist,
　then I don't need to pilot EVA either...」

stage0019_03:r_f42017dfce31dea9.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$...
　Do you not want to fight?」

stage0019_03:r_9e994a4b926d9906.text:
$$赤木$$
「Alright...!
　Then I'll talk to the higher-ups for you.」

stage0019_03:r_3ac462d37e5893ff.text:
$$赤木$$
「I don't know if I can or not.
　But you won't know till you try, right?」

stage0019_03:r_d38be46e6cd7a5e5.text:
$$赤木$$
「What is it?
　Do you want to fight, or not?
　Spit it out already.」

stage0019_03:r_c66844158d1ce600.text:
$$赤木$$
「Then why are you with the Crusher Team?」

stage0019_03:r_bcd53d14c4785426.text:
$$赤木$$
「Oh, is that all!
　You've got a proper reason to fight, then.」

stage0019_03:r_554ae12c4c170253.text:
$$赤木$$
「Your reason's wanting to live up to
　your dad's expectations, right? That's good enough.」

stage0019_03:r_ca3edf3b8b52aedf.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's different for everyone.
　I know a guy whose reason was debt...」

stage0019_03:r_304e98dac43c9333.text:
$$赤木$$
「Ah, yeah... just a slight headache, that's all...」

stage0019_03:r_b740d817a14afd3a.text:
$$赤木$$
「Anyway!
　Everyone has their own reason to fight,
　so what's in your heart matters most」

stage0019_03:r_40e4c010d1b35b4c.text:
$$赤木$$
「Just do what you want to do.
　If you want to live up to expectations but
　don't want to fight, find another way instead」

stage0019_03:r_c33abf00683a32bc.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Don't you look for that other way, $$赤木$$?」

stage0019_03:r_019293cb83599509.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Because... fighting is scary, isn't it...」

stage0019_03:r_9b949b9281aaeef1.text:
$$シンジ$$
「If you're attacked, it's scary, it hurts...
　and in the worst case, you could even die...」

stage0019_03:r_b39a1dd705fe6cbf.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's why I fight.
　Because I don't want anyone else to feel that fear」

stage0019_03:r_a684e6cea428e518.text:
$$赤木$$
「Sure, $$ダイ・ガード$$'s power is a tiny thing,
　so of course, there's a limit to what it can do...」

stage0019_03:r_cf907a4d5de8b5c9.text:
$$赤木$$
「But if $$ダイ・ガード$$ can still protect someone,
　then I'll do my best and fight」

stage0019_03:r_a5774604a0f00702.text:
$$赤木$$
「Everyone's living with everything they've got.
　I just want to protect that」

stage0019_03:r_b4fa30f33e84207f.text:
$$シンジ$$
「Everyone's living with everything they've got...」

stage0019_03:r_9133b7e0b34de48f.text:
$$赤木$$
「And let me say just one more thing.
　Thinking someone else will do it so you don't have to,
　I don't think that's right」

stage0019_03:r_7313331f4077d255.text:
$$赤木$$
「Because that's basically running away
　from what's happening around you」

stage0019_03:r_a84ab0c3c1ba44d4.text:
$$赤木$$
「If you keep saying that,
　it's like the world exists only around you, right?」

stage0019_03:r_83a9e41e15444c69.text:
$$シンジ$$
（$$ミサト$$ said it too...
　Protect... I protect... what I can protect...）

stage0019_03:r_09227dec2bd6f4d8.text:
$$シンジ$$
（I wonder if it's the same for the Crusher Team...
　Maybe everyone fights so desperately because
　they have a reason to fight despite being scared...）

stage0019_03:r_7b3a37f5039eb1f6.text:
$$佐伯$$
「So this is where you were, $$赤木$$!
　The briefing is about to start!」

stage0019_03:r_ddd97a6ef823929a.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Don't 'ugh' me.
　Don't you realize you're the center of this operation?」

stage0019_03:r_df349052cd9cdd0c.text:
$$佐伯$$
「At this rate, the New $$ダイ・ガード$$ we finally
　finished will be meaningless」

stage0019_03:r_a7ce9f908380694c.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$シンジ$$...
　This nagging guy is $$佐伯$$, the tactical advisor」

stage0019_03:r_de3cc1f733dcb073.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Nice to meet you, $$碇シンジ$$.
　You won't be joining this operation, but I'll
　need you to attend the briefing」

stage0019_03:r_c32efc7394910997.text:
$$赤木$$
「Let's go, $$シンジ$$.
　Seems like everyone's waiting for us」

stage0019_03:r_b01db8213417811e.text:
$$シンジ$$
（There are people... waiting for me...）

stage0019_03:r_7cf3c91395139f5c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「...I'm surprised, $$シンジ$$.
　That you'd decide to sortie on your own」

stage0019_03:r_fbe7bf7d854012a7.text:
$$赤木$$
「No need to apologize, $$シンジ$$.
　You did a good thing」

stage0019_03:r_1f438885dbc1359e.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Let me thank you too, $$シンジ$$」

stage0019_03:r_5d7a3adb077ad934.text:
$$佐伯$$
「Thanks to you, that village was saved.
　Because of your desperate charge」

stage0019_03:r_78d3b2a75e38d6f7.text:
$$甲児$$
「That guts of yours blew me away, $$シンジ$$」

stage0019_03:r_8d461de418389bf8.text:
$$ワッ太$$
「Though the charging tactic
　did seem very $$赤木$$-like」

stage0019_03:r_5cb2acefa1e7c7fb.text:
$$赤木$$
「$$ワッ太$$!
　What's that supposed to mean!?」

stage0019_03:r_59ce7fd9524ec8be.text:
$$いぶき$$
「It obviously means exactly what it sounds like」

stage0019_03:r_33f67c683bda9203.text:
$$青山$$
「And while we're at it, it's not a great tactic.
　That's the honest opinion of us riding along」

stage0019_03:r_476fb20ab9d18957.text:
$$いぶき$$
「That's exactly it, $$シンジ$$.
　It's fine to look up to $$赤木$$'s hero act,
　but don't copy his fighting style too」

stage0019_03:r_64f25294d71a5d55.text:
$$シンジ$$
「But this time I really felt sorry, so...」

stage0019_03:r_b6ca80db4741a62c.text:
$$ミサト$$
「That's fine, $$シンジ$$.
　You don't have to match everyone else, just
　put what you think and feel into words」

stage0019_03:r_56688ad8e41b7b42.text:
$$谷川$$
「I used the vegetables the villagers gave us
　as thanks to make some pork miso soup」

stage0019_03:r_1afedc9fa466f321.text:
$$中原$$
「There are rice balls too, so
　please eat plenty」

stage0019_03:r_9547b3241808695f.text:
$$大山$$
「$$赤木$$, make sure you wash your hands first」

stage0019_03:r_80f948aeaed93de8.text:
$$竜馬$$
「$$赤木$$'s a straight shooter to the extreme.
　For a guy like $$シンジ$$ who overthinks everything,
　he's probably the perfect teacher」

stage0019_03:r_0d24e9726dcc79f9.text:
$$スズネ$$
「Showing it through action, not words...
　I should learn from that too」

stage0019_03:r_ef339c6f71e7560f.text:
$$竜馬$$
「W, what, $n...!
　I was just, as a colleague, telling Miss $$スズネ$$...」

stage0019_03:r_ce68dd10a19e01ea.text:
$n
「You don't need to make excuses.
　I just... brought some pork miso soup」

stage0019_03:r_075101b23517fbaa.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Hey...!
　Isn't there any for me?」

stage0019_03:r_13c2ae299018c9ee.text:
$n
「I wouldn't know.
　You're not my partner, $$竜馬$$」

stage0019_03:r_6f4f8dd80820f5e7.text:
$$竜馬$$
「Tch... you've got some nerve too」

stage0019_03:r_afa513b4815df4c9.text:
$$スズネ$$
（I wonder if, $n...
　you were jealous...）

stage0019_03:r_e5a692ea5ce09cac.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「The Fourth Angel and its annihilation...
　Then, the requisition of the Third Child,
　and the first activation of EVA Unit-01...」

stage0019_03:r_2be6c657d0e12c4b.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Though Unit-01's huge repair bill was unplanned」

stage0019_03:r_f89f6c6c4b076e16.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Compared to the frozen Unit-00,
　it's hardly worth troubling over」

stage0019_03:r_7569f965fff4d791.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Even with some flaws, it just needs to
　prove useful when $$第５の使徒$$ appears」

stage0019_03:r_b43bdba9393d4d68.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Have no concern.
　Following Unit-01's deployment, Unit-02 and its
　assigned pilot are undergoing trials in Germany」

stage0019_03:r_3ec159d1a3492877.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「And Unit-03 onward, built as planned too」

stage0019_03:r_4e2fbafa9ebef558.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Proper operation of NERV and the EVAs is your duty.
　Please, whatever you do, don't disappoint us」

stage0019_03:r_bde2e27bac7e3317.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「Indeed... eliminating Angels is part of our $$リリス$$ pact」

stage0019_03:r_631834aa1545ba7b.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「As for that matter of Mycenae,
　we too shall proceed with our own investigation」

stage0019_03:r_c8b75f3bca245a85.text:
$$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$
「The Human Instrumentality Project...
　Its fulfillment is our ultimate wish」

stage0019_03:r_b26be73e3c0c8bed.text:
$$ゲンドウ$$
「Understood.
　Everything will proceed according to $$ＳＥＥＬＥ$$'s scenario」

stage0019_03:r_6c41647935e2574a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've been waiting, Master $$赤木$$.
　For everyone from $$２１世紀警備保障$$ to join us」

stage0019_03:r_ca702b5726ebd4da.text:
$$赤木$$
「So you're $$ＡＧ$$.
　I've heard the rumors」

stage0019_03:r_51ce1d8caa34c103.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, Master $$赤木$$...
　How much is your salary, if I may ask?」

stage0019_03:r_d00313056b19262c.text:
$$赤木$$
「That's a pretty blunt question out of nowhere...」

stage0019_03:r_d41f1e36365baa6f.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Actually, I... am a member of $$ＤＥＭ$$,
　but being a robot, I don't receive
　a single yen in salary or the like」

stage0019_03:r_2c37dd5b8f919a88.text:
$$赤木$$
「You mean you work for free...!?」

stage0019_03:r_53f5199f05a9aad8.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That's right.
　So, depending on the terms, I'm considering
　changing jobs to $$２１世紀警備保障$$」

stage0019_03:r_c6937f14a8985c35.text:
$$赤木$$
「Wait a minute!
　Working for free is odd, sure, but is it right
　to choose a job on salary alone!?」

stage0019_03:r_07513334490fbdf9.text:
$$赤木$$
「A job isn't something like that!
　It's more like, how do I put it, something you
　pour your passion into and give your all!」

stage0019_03:r_082a55c75a163780.text:
$$赤木$$
「Think about it carefully, $$ＡＧ$$.
　Do you... dislike your current job?」

stage0019_03:r_f5507082e5c31362.text:
$$赤木$$
「There's joy and fulfillment in that job too, right?
　Don't forget that」

stage0019_03:r_3c9956c9d519d2a2.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...You're right.
　When it comes to the $$ジェニオン$$ and $n,
　I have my own responsibility too...」

stage0019_03:r_d150caab246bbd7a.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you, Master $$赤木$$.
　I'm glad I consulted you after all」

stage0019_03:r_d23d30b65284f69d.text:
$$赤木$$
「Glad I could help too.
　Let's get along from now on, $$ＡＧ$$」

stage0019_03:r_b2f67d46499f2bbd.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「By the way, Master Akagi...
　What's your relation to Dr. $$赤木リツコ$$ of NERV?」

stage0019_03:r_fc1b13eaa4071b9a.text:
$$赤木$$
「I'm pretty sure we're not related...」

stage0019_03:r_c4cdd41ba9207e9c.text:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now that my doubts are settled,
　I too shall renew my resolve at work!
　So today too, let's get fired up... Business, business!」
